text: ah that world_loader, i would check on that because to my understanding i was aware of the root-living version of it, and then it was rewritten into scoped files, inside of the framework directory, any lingering world_loader not in pieces would be considerably old news iirc
resolution: Checked the world_loader two-copies concern: the current state is already correct. The Jul 11 split (84460c9cd) created framework/world_loader/ scoped pieces but left the root monolith live; the Jul 13 cutover (req_3041, 3e9ed7a69) deleted the root monolith and pointed every consumer plus rjit game's LOADER_SOURCE at framework/world_loader.zig, which is a 410-line facade over the split tree — one loader, in pieces, no lingering root copy. Fixed the facade's stale header comment that still cited the dead root -Dapp-source path (commit c3abb1f6d).
